research_updates.title: Investment audit - actuals and commitments separated
research_updates.notes: Source families checked: Apple newsroom/environmental archives, 2009 County/Town agreement minutes, Catawba FY2010-FY2026 budgets and ACFRs, NC Commerce/General Assembly grant reports, permits, assessor/tax pages, SEC/company filings and local reporting. Searches combined Apple, Project Dolphin, Maiden, Catawba, 5977/6028/6029 Startown, parcel 362711760090, the IM3 IDs, investment, capex, acquisition, equipment, expansion and financing across 2008-2026. Retained are the original $1 billion commitment, a county-reported FY2016/17 $432 million investment, the April 2022 $448 million expansion commitment and Apple's 2025 greater-than-$5-billion company/county cumulative lower bound. Their periods and scopes overlap, so they are never summed; no selected-building acquisition price, equipment ledger, annual capex series, debt, lease or verified $448 million realization was found.

source.title: Apple increases U.S. commitment to $600 billion, announces ambitious program
source.notes: Apple says construction is underway to expand Maiden capacity and that the expansion builds on more than $5 billion already invested in Catawba County. research_updates.title: Construction audit - original and later phases bounded
research_updates.notes: Source families checked: Catawba Building Services parcel/project/permit reports, MDN.06 index, Town/County minutes and planning documents, OSHA establishment searches, Apple announcements and contractor/architect searches. Exact identifiers and aliases covered 5977/6028/6029 Startown, 2201 Elbow, parcel 362711760090, BLDC-05-2022-171970, MDN.06, Maiden Tactical, Project Dolphin, Apple, Holder and Turner from 2008-2026. County FY2012 reporting supports more than 750 original construction jobs without hours or residence; the 2022 finaled MDN.06 report supports a separate 237,600-square-foot building and $25,176,096 administrative permit value. Three later MDN.06 building permits and the 2012 tactical/fuel-cell facility remain distinct; no complete permit valuation, contractor-payment, payroll, job-year, local-labor or selected-building cost ledger was found.

research_updates.title: Supplier audit - named firms without spend retained as context

Holder is named in contemporary construction reporting, Turner in the 2022 occupancy report and Skidmore on a 2020 patio permit, but none discloses payment, worker residence or a bounded local share. research_updates.title: Resource audit - long electricity series, no public water volumes
research_updates.notes: Source families checked: Apple environmental reports for 2012-2026, the AWS audit/certified-site register, City of Hickory water and Town of Maiden wastewater pages/reports, Duke Energy/NCUC tariff and docket searches, NCDEQ air/waste/stormwater records, EIA and renewable-project inventories. Exact entity/address/parcel queries included electricity, kWh, demand, bill, meter, rate, interconnection, PUE, WUE, water, gallons, withdrawal, wastewater, blowdown, generator, fuel, gas and emissions. Apple directly reports a FY2016-FY2025 campus electricity series rising from 244 to 470 million kWh; it is retained unallocated. Cooling-control savings are forecasts, zero gas is not zero backup fuel, and no water use, discharge, utility price, peak demand, PUE, generator count/runtime or selected-building resource record was found.

research_updates.title: Candidate-by-candidate modeling and county-outcome decision
research_updates.notes: Metric-specific eligibility review after both direct-evidence passes. Investment: rejected - cumulative, annual-highlight, commitment and permit amounts overlap and lack a selected-building allocation. Construction: rejected - worker residence, hours, payroll, local coefficients and a complete non-overlap permit/spend ledger are absent. Suppliers: rejected - contractor identities without payments, geography or local shares cannot support output. Operations: rejected - inconsistent dated headcount/contractor snapshots cannot generate annual FTE, payroll, wages, revenue or expense. Fiscal: rejected - assessed-value stocks and published rates cannot substitute for account bills, recipient receipts, refunds or incidence. Public costs: rejected - actual county payments have gaps, Town payments and same-scope service/infrastructure costs are missing, and applying the 50/85-percent formulas would create a counterfactual rather than an observation. Resources: rejected - campus kWh cannot be allocated to one building, and no meter, peak, PUE/WUE, water, fuel or cost inputs exist. Community: rejected - no project-attributable recipient amount exists. County employment: rejected - CBP/QCEW aggregates cannot isolate Apple, contractors or concurrent data-center activity and no defensible comparison design exists. County wages: rejected - composition change is not project payroll and has the same identification failure. County GDP: rejected - BEA county output has no validated treatment share, comparator or attribution design. Modeled additions: zero; forecasts added: four. Remaining gaps stay explicit rather than using arbitrary building shares, tax-rate multiplication, capacity conversion, transferred multipliers or unsupported causal effects.
